design_basis.adopted: 工作流输入使用结构化视觉事件，而不是只依赖单一 image 字面标签
视觉事件先作为独立输入通道进入工作流，再由后续 RAG/证据门决定是否可回答

bug_fixed.before: chat workflow readiness only counted PerceptionEvent.modality=image with non-empty text
bug_fixed.impact: ocr_region/image_region events produced by the current runtime could be rejected as missing screen evidence
bug_fixed.after: visual event modalities image/image_region/ocr_region count when text, bbox, or structured target candidates are present
bug_fixed.safety_boundary: this changes readiness detection only; visual confidence, authorization, project evidence, and citation gates remain unchanged

limits: 工作流准备通过不等于视觉识别正确，也不等于 RAG 或回答通过。
本修复没有放宽屏幕授权范围，没有引入后台录屏，也没有绕过项目文档证据门。
真实 30 条跨应用 episode、图标/图表准确率和完整链路 P95 仍未完成。
